says: The ticket 766 typecheck pull request (#1506) deleted scripts/typecheck.sh but left its line on the NOT_YET_PORTED list, so the tracked-scripts lint part fails on main.
proof: On origin/main 4909b55d, `git ls-tree origin/main scripts/typecheck.sh` finds no file, and oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts:35 still lists "scripts/typecheck.sh". Running `node oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts` prints: scripts/typecheck.sh is on NOT_YET_PORTED, and git does not track it: delete its line, since the list only shrinks. `git show 65edf5c2 --stat` shows scripts/typecheck.sh removed with 135 lines.
cost: pnpm lint fails on every branch until the line is deleted, and the list only shrinks (0524), so the fix is deleting one line.
